gui.autowindowsize.config.title: Auto Window Size
gui.autowindowsize.refreshing: Resizing window… auto-refreshes when you stop dragging
gui.autowindowsize.disabled_reason: ⚠ Config resolution is larger than your screen — min size lock auto-disabled
gui.autowindowsize.fullscreen_reason: ⚠ Lock and fixed-size are paused in fullscreen, restored when you exit
gui.autowindowsize.lock.button.disabled: Min Size Lock Unavailable (Resolution Too Low)
gui.autowindowsize.lock.tooltip: Once on, the window can grow but cannot shrink below the configured size (default 1280x720), keeping tuned UI layouts intact.
gui.autowindowsize.fixed.tooltip: Freezes the window at its current size: it can neither grow nor shrink, and the maximize button is disabled. Unavailable in fullscreen or while maximized.
gui.autowindowsize.autofs.tooltip: Start the game in fullscreen on the NEXT launch. Does not change the current window. Mutually exclusive with auto-maximize.
gui.autowindowsize.automax.tooltip: Start the game maximized on the NEXT launch; restoring afterwards returns to the config resolution and centers. Mutually exclusive with auto-fullscreen.
gui.autowindowsize.center.tooltip: One-click center on whichever monitor the window is on. Unavailable in fullscreen, maximized, minimized or when already centered.
gui.autowindowsize.preset.tooltip: Click to switch to this resolution immediately, center the window and save the config. Disabled in fullscreen or maximized.
